name: Hunter step 8: tracking polar kebbits in the Rellekka Hunter area (level 1). Inspect on the south hole shows the first footprints of a trail of the player's own; a hollow log away from where they lead shows nothing; a snow drift is empty while the trail goes on. The trail is random, so follow the rest by eye: Inspect the connectors where the footprints stop until one shows more, then Attack the snow drift where they end with the noose wand wielded (::keys on)
